output.reason: [ev-736cdc5fc0d2] says that on kernels 6.6 or newer, Cilium now uses tcx BPF links by default to attach its tc BPF programs. It says setups with third-party old-style tc BPF users "should" set bpf.enableTCX=false to keep the old attachment mode. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected or loses access. It only describes a changed default with an opt-out, so behavior-change (review) fits, and the proposed remediation matches the evidence.
